cue: A proof infers a harmonic spectral moment from convergence in probability of typical spectral size
fire_when: K/n^(1/3)->1 in probability is used to conclude E[1/K]=n^(-1/3+o(1)) without controlling low-degree mass
silent_when: A weighted low-degree tail estimate or uniform integrability of n^(1/3)/K has been proved, or the missing estimate is labeled a gap
text: A typical spectral size does not control E[1/K]. Check low-degree leakage: mass n^(-1/4) at K=1 changes the harmonic exponent despite convergence of K/n^(1/3). Write the weighted tail bound or leave it as a gap.
